title: Role-aware schema-only bundle generation for three-database Staging

phases.objective: Generate exact, checksummed, schema-only bundles from disposable MariaDB using a role-aware manifest, then let the existing Windows Staging importer seed the three isolated local databases without Production or provider access.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The operator runs the generator from a clean checkout pinned to an exact main SHA.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Three non-empty gzipped schema-only bundles and a checksum manifest are produced, with required runtime, governance, and persistence tables present and cross-role ownership violations blocked.
steps: Require an exact checked-out SHA and clean worktree.
Require a local Docker context and a disposable MariaDB build database.
Validate every migration for forbidden GRANT, account, provider, and external-data operations.
Apply the ordered migration chain only inside the disposable schema build database.
Partition the resulting tables into Runtime, Governance, and Runtime Persistence roles according to the reviewed manifest.
Emit no-data gzipped bundles and a source/migration/bundle SHA256 manifest.
Keep Production access, provider access, data export, secrets, and mutation false.
assertions: The manifest declares exactly three database roles with distinct database and user environment bindings.
Runtime excludes all Governance and Runtime Persistence contract tables.
Required baseline tables are checked before a bundle is emitted.
The generator is fail-closed on a dirty worktree, wrong SHA, non-local Docker context, forbidden SQL, missing table, empty bundle, or missing confirmation.
The output is schema-only and contains no INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, REPLACE, or LOAD DATA statements.
The output manifest binds the exact source commit, every migration checksum, every bundle checksum, and the three role table sets.
The existing importer remains the only path that applies bundles to local Staging containers.
No Production migration, grant, deployment, provider mutation, DNS mutation, or secret handling is introduced.
